groups.label: Straight lines and connectors
groups.use: Direct links, dividers, leaders, and reading-path spines.

presets.line: Straight line with the default diagonal orientation.
presets.lineInv: Straight line with the inverse default diagonal orientation.
presets.straightConnector1: Straight connector contour when connector object identity matters.

groups.label: Bent connectors
groups.use: Orthogonal routing around content or between aligned zones.

presets.bentConnector5: Four-bend orthogonal connector for more complex routing.

groups.label: Curved connectors
groups.use: Soft rerouting, feedback links, or relationships that must pass around objects.

presets.curvedConnector5: Four-segment curved connector for complex routing.

groups.label: Neutral rectangular carriers
groups.use: Content ownership, stable fields, and nodes that need no directional or symbolic inflection.

presets.rect: Fully neutral rectangular field or carrier.
presets.roundRect: Uniformly rounded carrier with a softer, more approachable boundary.

groups.label: Corner-inflected rectangles
groups.use: Carriers whose rounded or clipped corners mark an entry edge, open edge, or deck-wide contour language.

presets.round1Rect: One rounded corner for a single softened or attached edge.
presets.round2SameRect: Two rounded corners on one side, creating a clear opening or terminal edge.
presets.round2DiagRect: Two diagonally opposed rounded corners for reciprocal or diagonal tension.
presets.snipRoundRect: Mixed clipped and rounded corners for controlled technical contrast.
presets.snip1Rect: One clipped corner for a single technical or directional cue.
presets.snip2SameRect: Two clipped corners on one side for an open or connected edge.
presets.snip2DiagRect: Two diagonally clipped corners for diagonal rhythm or contrast.

groups.label: Triangular bodies
groups.use: Apex, escalation, directional focus, or a literal triangular object.

presets.triangle: Symmetric triangle for apex, priority, or upward/downward focus.
presets.rtTriangle: Right triangle for corner anchoring, diagonal split, or literal geometry.

groups.label: Slanted quadrilaterals
groups.use: Motion, transformation, comparison, or a sloped handoff between zones.

presets.diamond: Four-sided focal node for branching, opposition, or a literal diamond.
presets.parallelogram: Parallel slants for motion, transfer, or input/output-like movement.
presets.trapezoid: Symmetric widening or narrowing for expansion, compression, or stage change.
presets.nonIsoscelesTrapezoid: Asymmetric widening or narrowing for off-axis transition.

groups.label: Regular polygon bodies
groups.use: Compact nodes, numbered stages, badges, or radial systems where side count supports the visual language.

presets.heptagon: Seven-sided emblematic node with unusual visual rhythm.
presets.decagon: Ten-sided near-circular badge with faceted edges.
presets.dodecagon: Twelve-sided near-circular badge or radial node.

groups.label: Organic carriers
groups.use: Soft focal zones, ports, lenses, or organic contrast against angular geometry.

presets.ellipse: Continuous oval field, focal lens, or soft node.
presets.teardrop: Rounded body with one pointed focus for origin, destination, or literal drop imagery.

groups.label: Ornamental carriers
groups.use: A single high-emphasis label, title plate, or inset whose edge treatment matches the deck language.

presets.plaque: Concave-corner plate for a formal label, title, or emblem.
presets.bevel: Beveled rectangular body for a raised or inset focal surface.

groups.label: Radial contours and segments
groups.use: Cycles, apertures, partial reveals, circular zoning, or a curved page spine.

presets.pieWedge: Single circular wedge for a radial anchor or literal sector.
presets.pie: Circle with an adjustable missing sector for reveal or incomplete-cycle meaning.
presets.blockArc: Thick curved band for a cycle segment, portal, or curved spine.
presets.donut: Closed ring for circular containment, focus, or a literal ring.
presets.chord: Circular segment bounded by an arc and chord for overlap or partial-reveal geometry.
presets.arc: Open curved contour for a light boundary, trajectory, or partial frame.

groups.label: Frames, corners, and edge pieces
groups.use: Open ownership boundaries, page apertures, edge anchors, and corner-led composition.

presets.foldedCorner: Sheet-like carrier or accent with one folded corner.
presets.frame: Closed rectangular frame for a strong aperture or ownership boundary.
presets.halfFrame: Partially open frame for directional grouping or an incomplete boundary.
presets.corner: L-shaped corner piece for edge anchoring or a partial frame.
presets.diagStripe: Diagonal band for edge emphasis, slanted continuity, or a literal stripe.

groups.label: Brackets
groups.use: Collecting adjacent items, marking a range, or assigning a label to one side of a group.

presets.leftBracket: Left-side bracket that collects content to its right.
presets.rightBracket: Right-side bracket that collects content to its left.
presets.bracketPair: Paired brackets that enclose a complete range or set.

groups.label: Braces
groups.use: Visible grouping, aggregation, or one-to-many ownership where a bracket is too mechanical.

presets.leftBrace: Left-side brace that groups or assigns content to its right.
presets.rightBrace: Right-side brace that groups or assigns content to its left.
presets.bracePair: Paired braces that enclose a complete set.

groups.label: Literal pictograms
groups.use: A concept whose ordinary meaning is exactly the depicted object or symbol.

presets.cube: Literal cube or compact three-dimensional object.
presets.can: Literal cylinder, database-like store, or container.
presets.lightningBolt: Literal lightning, electricity, shock, or sudden-impact symbol.
presets.heart: Literal affection, preference, health-heart, or favorite symbol.
presets.sun: Literal sun, daylight, heat, or weather symbol.
presets.moon: Literal moon, night, sleep, or lunar symbol.
presets.noSmoking: Prohibition symbol with an adjustable slash over a target.
presets.cloud: Literal cloud, cloud-computing domain, or atmospheric thought field.

groups.label: Functional pictograms
groups.use: Literal mechanism, settings, processing, or filtering concepts.

presets.gear6: Six-tooth gear for a literal mechanism, settings, or interlocking process.
presets.gear9: Nine-tooth gear for a denser literal mechanism or system component.
presets.funnel: Literal filtering, narrowing, qualification, or conversion funnel.

groups.label: Plus symbol
groups.use: Literal addition, inclusion, medical-cross, or combined-value meaning.

presets.plus: Broad plus or cross body for literal addition, inclusion, or cross symbolism.

groups.label: Corner and edge tabs
groups.use: Four-corner framing, registration marks, or a technical aperture around a focal zone.

presets.cornerTabs: Four triangular corner tabs defining an implied rectangle.
presets.squareTabs: Four square edge tabs defining an implied rectangle.
presets.plaqueTabs: Four rounded corner tabs defining an implied rectangle.

groups.label: Partition symbols
groups.use: A literal four- or six-region partition, intersection, or hub motif.

presets.chartX: Rectangle divided diagonally into four triangular regions.
presets.chartStar: Rectangle divided into six regions by vertical and diagonal lines.
presets.chartPlus: Rectangle divided into four quarters by vertical and horizontal lines.

groups.label: Arrow-shaped carriers
groups.use: Stage bodies, handoffs, and compact process steps whose container and direction are one object.

presets.homePlate: Pentagon-like horizontal stage body with one pointed destination edge.
presets.chevron: Compact V-notched directional stage for repeated sequence or handoff.

groups.label: Cardinal block arrows
groups.use: Strong one-way movement, escalation, decline, or a dominant next-step direction.

presets.rightArrow: Strong left-to-right movement or next-step direction.
presets.leftArrow: Strong right-to-left movement, return, or reverse direction.
presets.upArrow: Strong upward movement, growth, or escalation.
presets.downArrow: Strong downward movement, decline, or descent.

groups.label: Stylized forward arrows
groups.use: Forward motion where the tail treatment communicates acceleration, entry, or interlock.

presets.stripedRightArrow: Right arrow with tail stripes for acceleration, launch, or staged entry.
presets.notchedRightArrow: Right arrow with an inward tail notch for interlock or handoff.

groups.label: Multi-axis arrows
groups.use: Reciprocity, branching, multi-way movement, or a hub with explicit directional alternatives.

presets.leftUpArrow: Two-route branch toward left and up.
presets.leftRightUpArrow: Three-route branch toward left, right, and up.
presets.quadArrow: Four-way hub or movement in all cardinal directions.

groups.label: Bent and return arrows
groups.use: A real turn, reroute, reversal, or return within a process path.

presets.bentArrow: Rounded right-angle route for a directional turn.
presets.uturnArrow: Explicit reversal, return, or loop-back path.

groups.label: Circular arrows
groups.use: Closed-loop processes, recurrence, refresh, or circular exchange.

presets.circularArrow: One-direction circular loop or refresh path.
presets.leftCircularArrow: Counter-oriented circular loop or return path.
presets.leftRightCircularArrow: Two-way circular exchange or reversible cycle.

groups.label: Curved and swoosh arrows
groups.use: Directional motion that must arc around a focal object or converge from an offset origin.

presets.curvedRightArrow: Curved path ending to the right.
presets.curvedLeftArrow: Curved path ending to the left.
presets.swooshArrow: Fast tapered sweep for launch, acceleration, or a dynamic handoff.

groups.label: Arrow callout bodies
groups.use: A short message whose body and directional emphasis must be one strong object.

presets.leftArrowCallout: Text-bearing callout with strong leftward direction.
presets.rightArrowCallout: Text-bearing callout with strong rightward direction.
presets.upArrowCallout: Text-bearing callout with strong upward direction.
presets.downArrowCallout: Text-bearing callout with strong downward direction.
presets.leftRightArrowCallout: Text-bearing callout for horizontal two-way emphasis.
presets.upDownArrowCallout: Text-bearing callout for vertical two-way emphasis.
presets.quadArrowCallout: Text-bearing callout for four-way or hub emphasis.

groups.label: Equation operators
groups.use: An explicit mathematical or logical operator between operands.

groups.label: Flowchart operations
groups.use: Exact conventional operation nodes inside an actual flowchart.

groups.label: Flowchart decisions and routing
groups.use: Exact branch, merge, junction, or continuation semantics inside an actual flowchart.

presets.flowChartOffpageConnector: Continuation to another page or diagram frame.
presets.flowChartCollate: Collate or reconcile inputs into an ordered result.
presets.flowChartExtract: Extract one stream or subset from another.
presets.flowChartMerge: Merge multiple flow paths into one.

groups.label: Flowchart input and output
groups.use: Exact data-entry or presentation nodes inside an actual flowchart.

presets.flowChartPunchedCard: Punched-card input or a deliberately historical medium.
presets.flowChartPunchedTape: Punched-tape input or a deliberately historical medium.

groups.label: Flowchart documents
groups.use: Document artifacts that enter, leave, or are produced by an actual flowchart.

presets.flowChartMultidocument: Multiple document artifacts or a document set.

groups.label: Flowchart storage
groups.use: Exact storage-media semantics inside an actual flowchart.

presets.flowChartMagneticDrum: Magnetic drum or direct-access historical storage.

groups.label: Flowchart terminator
groups.use: Start, end, or terminal state in an actual flowchart.

groups.label: Stars
groups.use: Literal rating, award, sparkle, burst, or one exceptional focal badge.

presets.star5: Conventional rating, award, or favorite star.
presets.star6: Six-point geometric star or literal emblem.
presets.star7: Seven-point unusual emblem or focal burst.
presets.star8: Eight-point badge, compass, or controlled burst.
presets.star10: Ten-point seal-like badge or radial emphasis.
presets.star12: Twelve-point seal-like badge or radial emphasis.
presets.star24: Very dense sparkle or burst accent.

groups.label: Irregular seals and explosions
groups.use: A literal burst, warning, sale seal, or exceptional interruption.

presets.irregularSeal1: Irregular burst with a coarser explosion edge.
presets.irregularSeal2: Irregular burst with a denser explosion edge.

groups.label: Straight ribbons
groups.use: One ceremonial title, milestone, award label, or section banner.

presets.ribbon: Banner with the center panel raised above its folded ends.
presets.ribbon2: Banner with the center panel lowered below its folded ends.
presets.leftRightRibbon: Straight ribbon with outward left and right tail emphasis.

groups.label: Curved ribbons
groups.use: A single arched title or badge whose curvature is part of the page composition.

presets.ellipseRibbon: Curved ribbon arcing upward around a central label.
presets.ellipseRibbon2: Curved ribbon arcing downward around a central label.

groups.label: Scrolls
groups.use: A literal scroll, proclamation, archival document, or deliberately historical motif.

presets.verticalScroll: Tall rolled document or vertical historical proclamation.
presets.horizontalScroll: Wide rolled document or horizontal historical proclamation.

groups.label: Waves
groups.use: Literal wave, oscillation, fluid motion, or one continuous undulating accent.

presets.wave: Single undulating band for literal wave or oscillation.
presets.doubleWave: Double undulating band for stronger ripple or oscillation.

groups.label: Leader-line callouts
groups.use: A short annotation that must visibly point to one object or region.

presets.callout1: Unbordered callout with a straight leader.
presets.callout2: Unbordered callout with one bent leader.
presets.callout3: Unbordered callout with a double-bent leader.
presets.accentCallout1: Straight-leader callout with an accent bar but no full border.
presets.accentCallout2: One-bend callout with an accent bar but no full border.
presets.accentCallout3: Double-bend callout with an accent bar but no full border.
presets.borderCallout1: Bordered callout with a straight leader.
presets.borderCallout2: Bordered callout with one bent leader.
presets.borderCallout3: Bordered callout with a double-bent leader.
presets.accentBorderCallout1: Bordered straight-leader callout with an accent bar.
presets.accentBorderCallout2: Bordered one-bend callout with an accent bar.
presets.accentBorderCallout3: Bordered double-bend callout with an accent bar.

groups.label: Wedge and thought callouts
groups.use: A speech, thought, or annotation body whose wedge visibly identifies the target.

presets.wedgeRectCallout: Rectangular annotation body with a pointed wedge to the target.
presets.wedgeRoundRectCallout: Rounded rectangular annotation body with a pointed wedge.
presets.wedgeEllipseCallout: Oval speech-like annotation body with a pointed wedge.
presets.cloudCallout: Cloud-shaped thought callout with a dotted tail.

groups.label: Action-button controls
groups.use: Interactive presentation controls when the matching click or hover action will also be assigned.

presets.actionButtonBlank: Blank action-button body for a custom control label or icon.
